# ProductionMenuScreen

## Purpose
The production menu on the left of the HUD: an endless, pooled scroll of the buildings the player can produce, each shown by the sprite CD_ProductionMenu gives its BuildType.

## Concepts
production menu, infinite scroll, object pooling, ProductionItem, CD_ProductionMenu, BuildType
